why: Intro to Git plan, 'Connect to GitHub with an SSH key'. `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` is still asking: the learner pressed Return at 'Enter file in which to save the key (/Users/tripi/.ssh/id_ed25519):' and the cursor now waits at 'Enter passphrase (empty for no passphrase):'. No key has been written yet (no 'Your public key has been saved' row, no fingerprint); the 'ed25519' and 'id_ed25519' the checks look for are in the prompts.

step.title: Make an SSH key
step.instructions: Make an ed25519 key: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com". Press Return to keep the default file, then type a passphrase twice.
